stem: 一家跨国金融机构(FI)发现涉及美国、德国和新加坡空壳公司的可疑交易,这些交易似乎是一起洗钱活动的一部分.德国金融情报机构(FIU)与美国金融犯罪执法网络(FinCEN)以及新加坡金融情报机构联合展开了调查.由于各国法律框架、数据隐私法和程序要求各不相同,调查面临诸多挑战.哪种方法最能促进这些司法管辖区内的监管机构和执法机构之间的合作,以确保调查取得成功？

options.A: 依靠各司法管辖区现有的法律框架和非正式沟通渠道
options.B: 聘请第三方咨询公司作为不同司法管辖区监管机构和执法机构之间的调解人
options.C: 将调查集中于反洗钱法律最为严格的司法管辖区进行,以简化流程并降低多司法管辖区协调的复杂性
options.D: 利用在国际金融犯罪调查领域具有公认专业知识的现有和新兴多边合作框架,以促进跨境合作

stem_en: A multinational financial institution (FI) detected suspicious transactions involving shell companies across the United States, Germany, and Singapore, which appeared to be part of a money laundering scheme. The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) in Germany initiated a joint investigation with the U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) and the Singapore FIU. The investigation faced challenges due to differing legal frameworks, data privacy laws, and procedural requirements. Which approach would best enhance cooperation between regulatory authorities and law enforcement agencies across these jurisdictions to ensure a successful investigation?

options_en.A: Relying on each jurisdiction's existing legal frameworks and informal communication channels
options_en.B: Engaging a third-party consulting firm to act as an intermediary between regulators and law enforcement agencies in different jurisdictions
options_en.C: Concentrating the investigation in the jurisdiction with the strictest AML laws to simplify the process and reduce multi-jurisdictional coordination complexity
options_en.D: Using existing and emerging multilateral cooperation frameworks with recognized expertise in international financial crime investigations to facilitate cross-border cooperation
